summary: Wicks expressed solidarity with Israel after the Oct 7 Hamas attack, calling the violence 'terrorism, plain and simple' and stating she 'stands with the Israeli people.'
quote: Going door-to-door, gunning down children and families, young people at a party, kidnapping innocent civilians -- this is terrorism, plain and simple. I stand with the Israeli people and pray for stability and peace.

summary: Wicks received $54,850 in total Israel lobby contributions from donors including Fisher, Silberstein, Katzenberg, Lauder, Bloomberg, Greuel, and Farber (2017-2025).
